description: An UNNUMBERED y/n gate from a CLI waiting on line input ([y/N] then Enter). Must be a user-waiting question with answer_style=text: a menu answer is the row's digit (web/cursor-pick.js), and there is no digit here, while a typed answer plus Enter is exactly what a [y/N] read wants.
